# Velytra (Extended LLM Context)

Velytra is positioned as a multisport training platform that connects workouts, analytics, follow-up, and communication between athlete and coach in one workspace.

Core positioning:
- Train with more context
- Not just logging, not just metrics, not just chat
- Built to support both athletes and coaches
- Designed to adapt across different sports

Current website scope:
- Catalan-first public launch website
- English and Spanish routes already exist but are placeholders marked under construction
- Public contact email: velytra@onmedic.org

Catalan V1 page set:
- `/ca/`
- `/ca/funcionalitats/`
- `/ca/atletes/`
- `/ca/entrenadors/`
- `/ca/faq/`
- `/ca/descarrega/`
- `/ca/contacte/`
- `/ca/privacitat/`
- `/ca/termes/`

Store links:
- App Store: not public yet
- Google Play: not public yet

Brand statement:
Velytra és una plataforma multi-esport que uneix entrenaments, analítica i seguiment entre atleta i entrenador per entrenar amb més criteri.
